requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The original requirement text contained an ambiguity regarding logical operator precedence. The controlled context (Business Rule BR-01) explicitly resolves this by defining the alarm trigger as: (Window Damage AND Intruder Detected) OR (Window Damage AND Door Opened Without Key). The supported interpretation is applied to structure the functional requirement.

source_fragments: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key, the safety system shall raise an alarm.

fields.condition: Window of the car is damaged AND (Interior surveillance detects an intruder OR Door is opened without a car key)

structured_requirements.final_statement: The safety system shall raise an alarm if the window of the car is damaged and either the interior surveillance detects an intruder or the door is opened without a car key.
structuring_notes: Decomposed the ambiguous logical structure based on Business Rule BR-01 to ensure precise trigger conditions: (Window Damage AND Intruder) OR (Window Damage AND Unauthorized Door Opening).
